events.summary: A fire broke out around 04:00 on 18 June 2022 in the No.1 ethylene glycol unit area of the chemicals division and spread to some nearby pipelines; one person died and one was lightly injured. events.summary: A drought in the Yangtze basin and record heat cut hydropower output (more than 80% of Sichuan's electricity) while demand surged. An emergency notice ordered a near-total production halt for industrial power users in 19 of the province's 21 prefecture-level divisions. Flag: system_wide.
events.effect: 《关于扩大工业企业让电于民实施范围的紧急通知》 (14 Aug): every industrial power user in the orderly-use plan, white-listed priority firms included, was ordered to halt production entirely (safety loads excepted) from 00:00 on 15 Aug to 24:00 on 20 Aug 2022, in every city or prefecture except Panzhihua and Liangshan. Reuters-syndicated and The Register reports say the curbs were later extended (The Register: 'to Saturday', i.e. 27 Aug). Named plants that halted include CATL Yibin (per Jiemian), Toyota's Chengdu JV and solar polysilicon makers.
events.threshold_basis: Hydropower generation shortfall forced provincial industrial power rationing, ordered officially.

events.operator: Shanxi Tongzhou Coal & Coke Group (山西通洲集团)
events.summary: A gas explosion at 19:29 on 22 May 2026 killed 82 and left 2 missing, China's deadliest mine disaster in about 17 years. The operator's four mines were ordered to halt, and blanket safety inspections swept Shanxi's coal sector.
events.effect: Xinhua: 责令山西通洲集团下属四座煤矿全部停产整顿 (all four of the group's mines ordered to halt for rectification). Sxcoal citing NBS: Shanxi raw coal output in June 2026 was 78.01 Mt, down 31.5% y/y, attributed to the explosion and the resulting suspensions. Reuters: national June output fell 9.7% y/y, the steepest drop since 2016. Xinhua (Oct 2026): Shanxi output fell more than 30% y/y in each month from June to August.
events.threshold_basis: Coal-mine disaster followed by a reported, quantified provincial supply cut (clause 7 also met).

capacity_affected.unit: percent y/y fall in Shanxi raw coal output, June 2026
capacity_affected.source_says: 78.01 million tonnes, down 31.5% year on year (Sxcoal, NBS data)

recovery.evidence: Xinhua (21 Oct 2026): Shanxi September raw coal output was 78.826 Mt, a four-month high; more than 200 mines had completed rectification and resumed production. In mid-September NDRC, NEA and the National Mine Safety Administration urged a safe return to full production. Return to pre-accident y/y output levels was not reported. The date is month-end of September, the month the output figure covers.
